title: Productize Your Dev Skills
audience: Developers whose services are broad, hard to explain, or difficult to buy.
shortDescription: Turn technical capabilities into a specific, sellable offer.
coreOutcome: Define what you sell, for whom, and why it matters.
problem: A long list of technical skills does not give a buyer a clear reason to hire you.
situation: You can deliver many kinds of work, but your offer changes with every conversation.
commonFailure: Leading with tools and capabilities makes the buyer assemble the business case themselves.
methodology: Move from technical capability to audience, costly problem, bounded outcome, scope, and proof plan.
capabilities: Describe the offer in buyer language
whoItsFor: Freelancers choosing or refining a service offer
whoItsNotFor: Developers seeking a universal offer that fits every client

seo.title: Productize Your Dev Skills | Prospect Foundry
seo.description: Turn technical capabilities into a clear, sellable development offer.
